name: sersergious-website
//engines: Node must be declared even though installs use Bun: `next` is a Node program (#!/usr/bin/env node, engines.node >=20.9.0). Declaring only `bun` here left Vercel provisioning a Bun-only build with no node on PATH, so `next build` died with `env: 'node': No such file or directory` (exit 127).
//overrides: CodeMirror identifies extensions with instanceof, so two copies of @codemirror/state break Sanity Vision's GROQ editor ('Unrecognized extension value in extension set'). @codemirror/view wants ^6.7.0 while its siblings accept ^6.0.0, which resolved to two versions. All ranges are compatible — pin one.
